# Eiffel Tower — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where is Eiffel Tower?", "Paris"),
    ("What is notable about Eiffel Tower?", "330 m"),
    ("What is location?", "Paris"),
    ("What is key stat?", "1889"),

]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
